about_the_game:
> SURVIVE, DEFEND, ESCAPE

Welcome back to another exciting episode of the Oddinary Farm Show!

You, the viewer, will look deeply into the tiny, feeble human mind as they struggle to survive on Earth(2).

Together or alone, they must farm, capture animals, and use the island’s resources to gather enough money to build a hot air balloon ~ their only chance to escape.

But beware: it’s not as easy as it sounds. We’ve seeded organic, non-GMO Alien-brand Scrum across the island. These creatures will help test the peak sillyness of our contestants.

Will they survive each night and make it through the great flood? Grab some human popcorn, sit back, relax, and find out.

It’s SHOW TIME.

> KEY FEATURES

  • Arcade-style Farming: wiki-free, straight-to-the-point, satisfying farming system.

  • Animal Taming & Management: Capture quirky animals around the island to help boost the productivity of the farm.

  • Exploration & Foraging: Farming is not the only way to escape. Discover the richness of the island and escape in your own style.

  • Building & Defense: Use common farming equipment such as turrets, landmines, and 40-inch reinforced concrete walls to fend off unwanted guests.

  • Single Player or Online Co-op: More friends, more ways to die. Or die alone.

  • Procedurally Generated Map: Vibrant living world where two runs technically never be the same.

short_description: You didn't sign up for the show, but now you have to survive it. As an unwilling contestant on an alien TV show, you must escape a strange island filled with bizarre wonders and quirky creatures before an impending flood consumes it.
